data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Wandis was the name of a nymph who guided wanderers and travelers. She was often depicted as a beautiful, graceful woman, who showed kindness and hospitality to those in need. The name Wandis carries the meaning “Wanderer, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wandis usually hope their child will grow to embody wanderer, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
